name: Three-part in-key harmony
desc: A diatonic third and fifth above in the song's key, spread left and centre: a stacked harmony choir

refs.why: real-time harmonies generated from Vernon's single voice
a harmonizer turning one voice into a chordal choir

notes: Scale: shift 4 = a third, shift2 7 = a fifth above. The key is a placeholder golem replaces per song. Unlike those records, the intervals follow the scale, not a keyboard
